digest.component_or_area: completion verifier harness / agentic verification seam
propositions: Production in-process verifier achieved 100% per-AC agreement with ground truth on the corpus (65/65 correct, 0 false-PASS, 0 false-FAIL on real ACs) whereas minimal external harness agent achieved 94.6% (87/92, 0 false-PASS, 5 false-FAIL on real ACs).

Predeclared GO condition (ii) requires Arm B rejections strictly less than Arm A rejections; observed Arm B=5 rejections vs Arm A=0, failing the decision rule and negating the hypothesis that unreliability lives in scaffolding rather than the task.
Arm B median wall time (415.5s) exceeded 2× Arm A median (262s threshold), failing predeclared GO condition (iii).

Arm B produced zero INSUFFICIENT verdicts by discovering ticket branches in the checkout and treating external-seeming ACs as in-tree-verifiable, contrary to the hypothesized insufficiency-loop pain point.
The 5 Arm B false-FAILs concentrated on epic 0e68 AC7 and AC2, reflecting strict literal readings of coverage-gap clauses rather than tooling constraints.
